leaf_gap_root_cause.cause: The three detailed budgets are top-sheet-plus-detail PDFs that extract column-wise (label and amount on separate lines). The parser sums a mixed population of top-sheet category rows and detail rows without applying the budget's ATL/BTL/fringes/contingency/bond hierarchy; fringe, contingency and bond appear as SECTION TOTALS rather than account-code rows and are not captured.
leaf_gap_root_cause.ownership: Deferred L1/L2/L3 budget work. NOT a disagreement with the source and NOT patched over.
leaf_gap_root_cause.guard: Test asserts parsed_leaf_sum + gap == oracle per fixture so the number cannot drift silently.

part_d_e_ingestion_and_routing.evidence: All six categories are present across the five resolved projects and route to their correct semantic homes: screenplay -> ScreenplayDocument/SA parser (FVD parsed to 99 scenes/38 characters), budget -> BudgetDocument/BudgetLineItems (Little Utopia 44 lines, FVD 34 lines), schedule -> versioned schedule documents (The System, 3 versions), artwork/deck/lookbook -> project media/document records.
part_d_e_ingestion_and_routing.no_silent_file_loss: Every DocumentVersion encountered is either linked to a semantic projection or retained as a versioned project source. Superseded versions are preserved, never deleted (Little Utopia screenplay x2 and deck x5; The System schedule x3).

part_f_g_holdout.separation: ScriptSideInputs (predictor-visible, screenplay-derived only) vs HeldOutActuals (budget, department totals, fringes, contingency, bond, shoot days, geography, schedule/DOOD refs, incentive/QPE).
enforcement: reveal_actuals() raises until close_prediction() is called — ordering is mechanical, not conventional.
Reading any held-out field raises unless that specific field was explicitly declared a producer-supplied input for that evaluation.
assert_no_leakage() scans payloads recursively BY VALUE, so a leak survives renaming or nesting.
Little Utopia and Tetrad are not holdout-eligible and raise if used for prediction evaluation.

part_h_validation_modes.guard: Test asserts both future-mode sets are empty so a later phase cannot quietly claim an unbuilt capability.
